title: Alice in Wonderland.
lines: On a warm summer's day Alice is sitting in the grass.
Her big sister is reading a book.
There are no pictures in it.
Then a white rabbit runs past.
He's wearing a little jacket and he's looking at a pocket watch.
The rabbit jumps into a big rabbit hole.
Past cupboards, jars of jam and clocks.
She lands in a room full of doors.
Behind it she sees a beautiful garden.
On a little table there's a little bottle.
Now she's as small as a mouse.
Then she finds a little cake.
Her head bumps against the ceiling.
Her tears become a big pool.
She shrinks again and swims through her own tears.
She comes to a wonderful forest.
A blue caterpillar is sitting on a mushroom.
In a tree sits a cat with a very wide grin.
First his tail, then his body.
She comes to a long table.
A mad hatter and a hare are sitting there.
Then Alice comes to the Queen of Hearts' garden.
Playing cards are painting the roses red.
Because the queen only wants red roses.
With a flamingo as a mallet and a hedgehog as a ball.
The queen gets angry with Alice.
All the cards run towards Alice.
Her sister is looking at her.
Was it all just a dream?
There she sees a white rabbit hopping away.
